PACKET METHOD 4 (Krawczyk grouping): engine.rs has 28 case-insensitive 'krawczyk' sites (anchor A1), all inside three distinct transformation carriers - the n=2 C1 (krawczyk_c1), n=3 C1 (krawczyk_c1_n3), n=4 C1 (krawczyk_c1_n4). They implement the SAME theorem transformation (Lemma 8.0 contraction + 8.2 Krawczyk existence/uniqueness/exclusion) at three arities with three distinct certificate carriers (PointCert, PointCert3, PointCert4); they are recorded as three rows, not 28, per the B-packet convention. The tube (Theorem 8.1) is a DIFFERENT transformation and is its own row (c2_certify_tube4). VERTICAL GAP (packet method 1, recorded not fixed): (a) winding_number's soundness precondition is the caller's certified-off-loop property, but its signature takes only [f64; 2] and does not carry the OffLoopCert that certify_off_loop produced; sample_inside is the only caller that composes them and it re-derives/discards the evidence. The off-loop guarantee is therefore NOT carried across the certify_off_loop -> winding_number transition. (b) trim_clip consumes certified crossings and produces a CertifiedGraph with TopoNode::TrimCrossing nodes, but the frozen CertifiedGraph has no per-arc winding field (assemble.rs records this as a frozen-shape amendment that is NOT made); the winding computed during classification is carried only as the discard/retain decision, not as evidence on the emitted graph. (c) the S9b seam: assemble.rs condition 3 (monotone arclength reparameterization / EdgeSampleLedger) is NOT reachable through this tree's public path; deck_identify records the winding on SegmentBreak::DeckStep breaks instead, and promote.rs re-derives the arclength table from the approximant. (d) the S3c pcurve seam: trimclip does not extract polynomial pcurves from topology; an arc is clippable only when its certified trace is the straight segment between its certified chart ends (arc_pcurve_leaf recovers a degree-1 BezierLeaf1), otherwise TrimClipFailed. (e) claims.rs LeafPair is defined locally because the census's landed seam is not present in the tree and BG-KV2-502-S9B is not merged. THEORY-ONLY / PENDING-CODE ROWS (B-packet method 2 distinction preserved): atlas.rs cone and torus chart leaves certify NOTHING on box claims - ChartPatch::regularity/weight_bound return ClaimVerdict::Inconclusive(CONE_FORM_PENDING / TORUS_FORM_PENDING) and enclose/derivs/normal_cone return the no-certificate NaN markers; only the chart STRUCTURE (ids, regions, apex-excluding boxes, transitions, degeneracy routing) is landed. FRAGMENT/MESH CLASSIFICATION (packet method 2): the packet names FragmentMesh, material states, and winding as C-scope classifier rules. FragmentMesh and the material-state variants are NOT present anywhere in vendor/truck/truck-certified/src/kernel (grep confirms); the landed C-scope classifier vocabulary is ComponentKind (claims.rs) and the winding/inside classifier (trimclip.rs), plus the sheet/degeneracy classifiers. The FragmentMesh/material-state surface lives in truck-shapeops (see loop/results/BG-SOL-RW2-SPLIT.json), outside this packet's read scope - recorded as a scope boundary, not a vertical gap. TRIMCROSSING/R9 EVIDENCE (packet method 3): CertifiedCrossing (PointCert R9-stamped + chart point), CertifiedExclusion, and OffLoopCert are the crossing record types; certify_crossings constructs CertifiedCrossing, event_node lifts it to a TopoNode::TrimCrossing Node with NodeCert::Exact, and promote's condition_trim_events gates that a Crossing event carries ResidualId::R9. ANCHORS: A1 = 28 (grep -ci krawczyk engine.rs), A2 = 5 (grep -c 'pub fn' assemble.rs) - both hold at this revision. No subsystem required a STOP for structural mismatch: every in-scope construct is expressible in the RULES schema (the unmodeled values above are value-level !unmodeled findings, not shape failures).
